verdict.rationale: BAMF is a government agency, so an offline paper, fax or mail fallback for completing its procedures is a fair question. The evidence only says the Integration section lists telephone numbers and contact addresses for further information (bamf-docs-4) and that service teams answer questions (bamf-docs-3). Nothing shows a published offline rail with exact postal addresses, fax numbers or downloadable forms for completing a task when the online flow is down.
